data.title: Mackenzie Cramblit
data.deck: A personal brand for a career coach who needs to feel experienced, direct and approachable.
data.intro: Mackenzie Cramblit works with management consultants who are deciding what comes next in their careers. The brand needed to feel credible without becoming corporate, and personal without becoming casual. The identity was shaped around that tension, using positioning, typography, colour and social applications to give her a clear, consistent presence.

data.title: Mackenzie Cramblit
data.deck: A personal brand for a career coach who needs to feel experienced, direct and approachable.
data.services: Personal brand strategy / Visual identity / Brand guidelines / Social media design
data.intro: Mackenzie Cramblit works with management consultants who are deciding what comes next in their careers. The brand needed to feel credible without becoming corporate, and personal without becoming casual. The identity was shaped around that tension, using positioning, typography, colour and social applications to give her a clear, consistent presence.
data.decision: The direction starts with the audience: ambitious professionals who value sound reasoning but also need reassurance. Structured layouts and a deep blue foundation bring authority; teal, warmer accents and expressive typography introduce a more approachable voice. The aim is a presence that feels credible without becoming corporate or distant.
data.system: The guidelines connect audience insight with everyday design decisions. Poppins provides a clear typographic foundation, with Playfair Display adding contrast for selected statements and editorial moments. Defined colour roles, image treatments, illustration guidance and icon rules keep the visual language coherent. Voice principles connect clarity and confidence with transformation, achievement and well-being.
data.design_copy: The following 17 guideline slides move from positioning and audience to typography, colour, tone and application. Social templates and profile treatments show how the direction can carry across a personal brand’s daily communication. Open a slide to inspect the original detail.
goals: Clarify how authority and approachability should show up in the brand
Turn audience insight into practical visual and verbal principles
Give LinkedIn and brand communications a repeatable design system
deliverables: Personal brand positioning and audience guidance
Poppins and Playfair Display typography guidance
